description: Source code for the MessageControl plugin implementation, including class definitions, initialization, deinitialization, and WebSocket handling.

classes.name: MessageControl
classes.description: Implements message control functionalities, including initialization, deinitialization, WebSocket attachment, and message handling.

classes.name: MessageControl::Config::NetworkNode
classes.description: Configuration class for network node settings, including port and binding address.

methods.name: MessageControl::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MessageControl plugin, sets up message output, registers callbacks, and configures WebSocket exporter.

methods.name: MessageControl::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters callbacks, releases interfaces, and terminates connections.

methods.name: MessageControl::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: MessageControl::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a WebSocket channel for communication.

methods.name: MessageControl::Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages, either as command or with specific ID and JSON element.
